name: reth
description: Reth 2.5.2 with a private local development chain and RPC accessible inside the workspace. Includes the pinned executable, not a Rust source-build environment.
prepare:
import hashlib, io, json, pathlib, platform, subprocess, tarfile, time, urllib.request
root = pathlib.Path('/workspace')
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assert platform.machine() == 'x86_64', 'This recipe requires x86_64 Linux'
url = 'https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/releases/download/v2.5.2/reth-v2.5.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz'
data = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=90).read()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == 'e360895ac51b351ff0c44573f0f619bb1e7c3ff2df55502af1190c14c9b5ef6d', 'Reth archive digest mismatch'
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data), mode='r:gz') as archive:
    members = [member for member in archive.getmembers() if pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name).name == 'reth' and member.isfile()]
    assert len(members) == 1, 'Expected one Reth executable'
    binary = root / 'reth'
    binary.write_bytes(archive.extractfile(members[0]).read())
    binary.chmod(0o700)
subprocess.run([str(binary), '--version'], check=True)

import json,pathlib,subprocess,time,urllib.request
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace')
binary=root/'reth'
log = (root / 'reth.log').open('ab')
process = subprocess.Popen([str(binary), 'node', '--dev', '--http', '--http.addr', '127.0.0.1', '--datadir', str(root / 'chain')], stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=log, start_new_session=True)
(root / 'reth.pid').write_text(str(process.pid))
for attempt in range(30):
    if process.poll() is not None:
        raise RuntimeError((root / 'reth.log').read_text()[-2000:])
    try:
        request = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8545', data=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'eth_chainId','params':[]}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=1))
        assert response.get('result'), response
        print(json.dumps({'reth':'2.5.2','rpc':'http://127.0.0.1:8545','chainId':response['result']}))
        break
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(1)
else:
    raise RuntimeError('Reth RPC did not become ready; inspect /workspace/reth.log')

checks.name: development-chain
